episodes.synopsis: Socially awkward Kannawa is tasked to mentor the newbie, Kamegawa. Can she pull off being the cool senpai?
episodes.title: ME? THE MENTOR?!

episodes.synopsis: Kannawa tackles a new challenge: Inviting her junior to lunch!
episodes.title: I Wanna Invite My Junior to Lunch!

episodes.synopsis: Kannawa needs to help her junior plan an office drinking party.
episodes.title: I Gotta Support the Drinking Party's Organizer!

episodes.synopsis: Kannawa and Kamegawa goes on a business trip to Okinawa. What could go wrong?
episodes.title: The Really Hot Okinawa Business Trip!

episodes.synopsis: Kannawa needs to show Kamegawa that she is prepared to work even during a rainy typhoon!
episodes.title: It's All the Typhoon's Fault!

episodes.synopsis: Kannawa struggles to ask Kamegawa out for drinks, but is instead invited to go to a festival with the newbies!
episodes.title: A Yukata Is the Norm for Fireworks Festivals

episodes.synopsis: Kannawa's mom makes a surprise visit, and she needs to fool her into thinking she has a boyfriend!
episodes.title: Mom's Comin' to Visit!

episodes.synopsis: The grand opening for Kamegawa's first project, a collab maid cafe, begins!
episodes.title: I'm Gonna Be a Maid!

episodes.synopsis: Kankaiji, Kannawa's long time cohort, joins the group for a spa day! But could they be more than cohorts?
episodes.title: Then Why Can't I Stop Thinkin' 'Bout It?

episodes.synopsis: Kamegawa is sick! As his senpai, Kannawa decides to check on him. But who's this mystery girl at his house?
episodes.title: I'm Gonna Visit My Junior!

episodes.synopsis: Kannawa wants to celebrate Kamegawa's birthday with extra care.
episodes.title: We're Gonna Celebrate Yer Birthday to the Fullest!

episodes.synopsis: Kannawa and Kamegawa want to be more than just friends. But can they overcome Kannawa's awkwardness?
episodes.title: I Really Thought About It, Ya Know?!
